These behaviors are already present in the owned trigger on both lines, contrary to the old read note saying they were absent. The public view injector resolves the observer without changing the historical11-argument constructor. The upstream modern-spec75px-to100px adjustment is not adopted into the original legacy positioning assertion; no golden, HTML, CSS, SCSS or TypeScript API change is made.
